title: Conditions, Results, Tags, Blocks, and Delegation
objective: Control task outcomes and orchestration flow explicitly.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: register captures module results for when expressions. changed_when and failed_when refine outcome semantics; ignore_errors should be rare because it discards useful control flow.
Blocks group tasks and support rescue and always behavior. Tags select subsets, delegate_to moves one task, run_once limits execution, and wait_for coordinates service readiness.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Control task outcomes and orchestration flow explicitly.

  selection: tags
